name: lucidmate
description: LUCIDMATE — Neon chess for RUN.world, built with PixiJS 8 (WebGPU-first).

scripts.build:multiplayer: npm run typecheck && cross-env RUNDOT_MULTIPLAYER=1 vite build && node scripts/check-build.mjs embedded
scripts.test: node scripts/test-noise-random.mjs && node scripts/test-social-model.mjs && node scripts/test-online-errors.ts && node scripts/test-room-notifications.ts && node scripts/test-platform-systems.ts && node scripts/check-safe-area.ts && node scripts/simulate.mjs && node scripts/check-game.mjs && node scripts/test-ui-layout.mjs
scripts.test:multiplayer: node scripts/qa-rivals-flow.mjs && node scripts/qa-correspondence-turn-flow.mjs && node scripts/qa-correspondence-management.mjs
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && node scripts/check-build.mjs multiplayer
scripts.build:bundled: npm run typecheck && cross-env RUNDOT_GAME_DISABLE_EMBEDDED_LIBS=true vite build && node scripts/check-build.mjs bundled
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run audit:public && npm run build && npm run build:bundled
